title: Mill no. 4. Bridge from mill no. 1 to mill no. 4 (NYPL b11707685-G90F077 014ZF)
blurb: * Eight of the stereographs are labelled as proofs, with the number of copies ordered noted. Seven of the stereographs are the finished version, with printed labels, six of which duplicate images represented as proofs. Proofs numbered 16, 18, 22-26, 28. Robert Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views. Views of the Willimantic Linen Company showing mill no. 2 and mill no. 4, the bridge leading to mill no. 4. and the store house; interior views include roving and reeling machinery, engines and counter shafts, the ring twisting department and the inspecting room. Statement of responsibility : by A. H. Folsom.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.28% vertical error and 0.02° of rotation. Depth measured moderate (1.99% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at 86% size.
